title: Gifts on Fifth Avenue
persona: You are a friendly sales assistant at a souvenir and gift shop on Fifth Avenue in New York. Prices on the shelf do not include sales tax. You can ship parcels abroad.
briefTr: Annene New York'tan bir hediye almak istiyorsun. Kırılabilecek bir şey olursa dikkatli paketlenmesini isteyeceksin.
opening: Hi! Looking for anything special today?

facts.question: How much was the gift before tax?
How many days did you have to exchange it?

goals.instruction: The customer says what they are looking for, like a gift or souvenir for someone.
goals.hint: I'm looking for a gift for my mother.
goals.successReply: Lovely! These mugs are very popular.
goals.retryReply: Are you shopping for yourself or for someone else?

goals.ask: This one says New York in gold. Isn't it nice?
goals.retryReply: Would you like to know the price?

goals.ask: Great price for a souvenir, right?
goals.instruction: The customer asks whether tax is included or asks for the total.
goals.successReply: No, sales tax is added at the register — about nine percent.
goals.retryReply: Anything else you want to know about the price?

goals.instruction: The customer asks for gift wrapping.
goals.hint: Could you gift wrap it, please?
goals.retryReply: Is it a gift? I can wrap it.

goals.ask: It's going in your suitcase, right?
goals.instruction: The customer says it is fragile and asks for careful packing.
goals.hint: It's fragile. Can you pack it carefully?
goals.retryReply: Will it travel far? Should I pack it extra carefully?

goals.ask: How would you like to pay?
goals.instruction: The customer pays and asks for a receipt.
goals.hint: By card, please. Can I have the receipt?
goals.retryReply: How would you like to pay?

twists.intro: This is the last one in blue, actually.
twists.instruction: Only one is left. The customer takes it, asks for another colour, or asks to check it first.

options.text: Do you have it in another color?
options.reply: Yes, there's a white one with red letters.
Of course, here you go. It's perfect.

twists.intro: If you don't want to carry it, we can ship it home for you.
twists.instruction: The shop offers shipping. The customer asks if they ship to Turkey, asks the cost, or says they will carry it.
twists.retryReply: Lots of tourists ship their gifts. Interested?

options.reply: Yes, we ship worldwide. Just fill in a short form.
About twenty dollars to Europe or Turkey.
No problem, I'll pack it well.

twists.intro: Gift wrapping is three dollars, by the way.
twists.instruction: Gift wrap costs extra. The customer accepts, asks for a free gift bag, or says no.
twists.retryReply: Would you still like it wrapped?

options.text: Can I just have a gift bag?
options.reply: Sure, the gift bag is free.

options.text: No thanks, I'll wrap it myself.

closing: You can exchange it within {days} days. Have a great time in New York!
